label: Nothing that is being moved in a…, from Nothing is moved except insofar as it is in… and 2 more
meaning: Per-sense argument, IN-ACT_3 (formal-or-virtual act): both act premises read inclusively give no self-motion in the same respect. The inclusive non-simultaneity premise is the stronger one: it must exclude virtual act together with formal potency.

strong_version_needed.d9daeb1e-1749-5473-9fae-04184dd5e40c: Each per-sense argument keeps both act premises in its one sense (IN-ACT_3). The weak IN-ACT_1 non-simultaneity with the IN-ACT_3 mover premise is the mixed reading, which the TERM-SENSE-FORKS-2-CONTROLS model refutes.
